# Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements:** Add a hover tooltip displaying the profile name on each profile avatar rendered in the message header avatars group (`ChatEntry.vue`). **Context found:** The avatars group uses DaisyUI's `avatar-group` and iterates `messageProfiles` with ``. A prior implementation pattern in the codebase wrapped each avatar in a `
`, and `ProfileAvatar`'s root also confirms `profile.name` is the display name. This is the established, reusable pattern. **Strategic Approach:** Wrap the `ProfileAvatar` loop item in a tooltip `
` using DaisyUI's `tooltip` utility class, binding `data-tip` to the profile name. No logic, data, or computed changes needed → minimal, structural-only change. **Dependencies & Risks:** None — `messageProfiles` already provides `profile.name` / `profile.username`. The wrapping div is a sibling-level element inside the existing `avatar-group`; overlapping spacing (`-space-x-3`) is preserved because the tooltip wrapper becomes the group child (rendered inline by default). Kept `tooltip-top` to avoid clipping against the sticky header/border below. **Target Files:** - `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` — Modify (template only) --- # Minimum Changes Approach Only the avatars block inside the header row is touched. The `ProfileAvatar` items are wrapped in a tooltip container. All existing props, keys, classes, and behavior remain unchanged. --- # File changes, Code Block Formatting & Proposed Changes ```vue src/components/ChatEntry.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/client/src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | Template → Avatars group (`messageProfiles` loop) | Wrapped `` in a `
` so hovering an avatar reveals the profile name. No script/data/computed changes. | --- ## Notes on the Decision - **Placement (`tooltip-top`):** The header row is sticky with `border-b` underneath — a top-positioned tooltip renders above the avatar, avoiding overlap with the content block below. - **Fallback binding (`profile.name || profile.username`):** `messageProfiles` returns a mixed list (users have `username`; profiles have `name`), so the fallback keeps the tooltip meaningful in both cases — the same resilience used elsewhere in the codebase (`ChatSidebar.vue`, `TaskCardLite.vue`). - **Accessibility:** The tooltip is purely supplementary; the username text (`displayMessage.user`) remains the primary, screen-reader-accessible identity, so no `aria-label` duplication is introduced.
